functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.shop_admin_list_activation_codes()
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, code_hint text, created_at timestamp with time zone, expires_at timestamp with time zone, redeemed_at timestamp with time zone, revoked_at timestamp with time zone, device_id uuid, activation_revoked_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if not public.shop_is_admin() then raise exception 'دسترسی مدیر لازم است'; end if;
  return query
  select c.id, c.code_hint, c.created_at, c.expires_at, c.redeemed_at, c.revoked_at,
         a.device_id, a.revoked_at
  from public.shop_activation_codes c
  left join public.shop_activations a on a.activation_code_id = c.id
  order by c.created_at desc
  limit 100;
end;
$function$

functions.name: shop_admin_revoke_activation
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.shop_admin_revoke_activation(p_device_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if not public.shop_is_admin() then raise exception 'دسترسی مدیر لازم است'; end if;
  update public.shop_activations
     set revoked_at = coalesce(revoked_at, now())
   where device_id = p_device_id;
end;
$function$

functions.name: shop_admin_revoke_activation_code
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.shop_admin_revoke_activation_code(p_code_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if not public.shop_is_admin() then raise exception 'دسترسی مدیر لازم است'; end if;
  update public.shop_activation_codes
     set revoked_at = coalesce(revoked_at, now())
   where id = p_code_id and redeemed_at is null;
end;
$function$

functions.name: shop_check_activation
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.shop_check_activation(p_device_id uuid, p_device_secret text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select p_device_id is not null
     and length(coalesce(p_device_secret,'')) >= 32
     and exists (
       select 1 from public.shop_activations a
       where a.device_id = p_device_id
         and a.secret_hash = encode(extensions.digest(p_device_secret, 'sha256'), 'hex')
         and a.revoked_at is null
     );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.shop_get_products(p_uid uuid)
 RETURNS SETOF shop_products
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if public.shop_can_order(p_uid) or public.shop_is_admin() then
    return query select * from public.shop_products order by id;
  end if;
  return;
end
$function$

functions.name: shop_is_admin
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.shop_is_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (select 1 from public.shop_admins where lower(email) = lower(coalesce(auth.jwt() ->> 'email', '')))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.shop_track_order(p_code text)
 RETURNS TABLE(status text, created_at timestamp with time zone, total numeric, customer_confirmed_at timestamp with time zone, delivered_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select o.status, o.created_at, o.total, o.customer_confirmed_at, o.delivered_at
  from public.shop_orders o where o.tracking_code = upper(trim(p_code)) limit 1
$function$
